title: Unpacking data elements

blocks.text: Run `practice/fields/Fields.java` and read what it prints. Then change it: add a data element to the sample message and teach `unpack` to read it, or make it print the field numbers the bitmap claims are present.
Lesson: a practice with no grader

Nothing checks this file, and that is not a shortfall. Some material is worth running and reading rather than scoring, and a practice that says so honestly is better than one with a grader invented for it. There is a Run button here and no Submit button, because there is nothing to submit to.
